correctness.rationale: The exact three-state generator and incoming characteristic boundary conditions give a solvable 2x2 first-order system; the resulting hyperbolic formula satisfies both boundaries and the equations. Its s=0 derivative yields the exact mean; a uniform complex-analytic expansion of F(alpha*z) gives all fixed integer moment coefficients. A first-flip coupling gives the conditional Exp(2) limit and typical ballistic convergence. The standalone extracted checker reproduces 30 symbolic, high-precision and event-driven diagnostics. All quantifiers require v,H,alpha>0, 0<x<=H and initially closing relative speed.

value.rationale: The kinetic entry time into a first jam is a natural transient quantity, distinct from a stationary jam fraction or mixing time. Low reversal rates produce a qualitative discrepancy: near-certain ballistic arrival but twice the ballistic limiting mean and unbounded higher moments with all exact coefficients, a nonuniform-integrability mechanism with physical interpretation as rare immobilization episodes. The complete full-positive-parameter Laplace formula and all-order singular asymptotics supply substantive structure rather than a routine parameter substitution.
